jobs.name: Vanguard Knight
jobs.items: One simple straight knight sword and one kite shield. Ivory/silver blade, short golden crossguard, dark-blue grip, gold pommel. Shield has a royal-blue field, broad gold rim, one simple ivory diamond emblem; no sculpted lion. Back: simple warm-brown inner shield and two leather arm straps. Small golden central blade detail allowed. No magic glow. Labels: Sword, Shield.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean FRONT AND BACK fantasy game equipment modeling reference sheet.
Primary request: Design only the specified hero's detached weapons and items, without a character, hands, clothing, or body.
Input images: Image 1 is the PRIMARY style reference: simple chunky low-poly shapes, broad plain color areas, readable chibi fantasy proportions. Image 2 is only a loose equipment/theme reference; simplify its intricate details dramatically.
Style: rendered 3D low-poly geometry with smooth shading on round shafts, orbs, leather and rounded surfaces; a few crisp broad facets on blades and crystals. Very simple construction suitable for easy low-poly modeling. Solid-color materials, NO painted textures, NO grain, NO scratches, NO weathering, NO tiny engraving, NO filigree. Matte or softly satin materials. Tiny restrained glow only when specified, never hiding the geometry.
Layout: one wide landscape sheet, two balanced columns. Left column labeled FRONT, right column labeled BACK. Show the COMPLETE SAME item set in both columns at identical scale, individually separated with generous whitespace, upright and entirely in frame. Back column must be the actual 180-degree reverse side of these SAME objects, not a second design or recolor. Shield backs must show a plain inner face and simple straps/grip. Quiver backs must show their attachment strap. Front and reverse crossbow views should show enough slight elevated angle to read the stock and bow structure while remaining a matched pair. No decorative borders. Small clean centered hero name at the top. Small item-name labels are welcome. Warm light-gray neutral studio background and soft light, faint grounded shadows. Equipment only.
Constraints: Exactly the requested item types. Do not add extra equipment. Do not show the hero. Do not copy complex ornament from reference 2. No modern optics, guns, tactical parts, gears or machinery. Favor bold silhouette and compact chunky proportions over detail.
Hero name (verbatim): "Vanguard Knight".
Requested item set and design: One simple straight knight sword and one kite shield. Ivory/silver blade, short golden crossguard, dark-blue grip, gold pommel. Shield has a royal-blue field, broad gold rim, one simple ivory diamond emblem; no sculpted lion. Back: simple warm-brown inner shield and two leather arm straps. Small golden central blade detail allowed. No magic glow. Labels: Sword, Shield.

jobs.name: Ranger
jobs.items: One simple curved wooden longbow, ONE loose arrow, and one light narrow leather quiver with a slim carry strap and only a few arrow ends visible at the opening. Warm brown wood and leather, muted forest-green accents; one or two large leaf motifs at most. String must be clearly present; arrow has an uncomplicated gray triangular head and cream fletching. Lightweight rustic medieval equipment, no ornate vines covering everything. Labels: Bow, Arrow, Light quiver.

jobs.name: Arcanist
jobs.items: One staff and a small cluster of THREE separate floating magical spherical orbs. Purple and lavender solid glowing spheres, smooth simple round surfaces, tiny restrained emission. Staff is a straight dark-purple shaft with lavender grip bands and a large simple violet crystal held in a minimal angular gold fork. Ivory/lavender/gold accents match the Arcanist. jobs.items: One plant orb and one green staff. The plant orb is a simple smooth jade-green sphere cupped by three large chunky leaf shapes, like a living seed. Staff is a simple green-tinted wooden stem with a modest curved fork at top and two broad leaves, brown grip and moss-green bands. jobs.items: ONE cool curved dagger design, shown once from the front and once from the back. A broad short swept hook-shaped silver blade with dark charcoal spine and a single deep-red inset, small angular dark guard and a sturdy burgundy wrapped grip, simple gray pommel. Strong clean menacing silhouette matching the black and red Demon Hunter. This dagger will be duplicated for dual wielding later, so do NOT show a pair in either column. No scabbard. Label: Dagger.

jobs.name: Crossbowman
jobs.items: One medieval crossbow and one heavy box-shaped bolt quiver. Crossbow made of stout brown wooden stock, simple dark-steel bow limbs, taut string and one simple release lever; a few plain iron bands only. Short compact stock, clearly recognizable medieval crossbow. NO firearm receiver, NO modern trigger grip, NO scope, NO gears or decorative mechanisms. Quiver is a sturdy rectangular dark-brown leather/wood bolt case with broad iron corner bands, a simple carrying strap on back, open top with a few short bolt ends. Muted burgundy small accent. Labels: Crossbow, Heavy quiver box.

jobs.name: Warlock
jobs.items: One hanging magical CENSER and one staff. Censer means a small incense burner, NOT an electronic sensor: a squat faceted dark-metal lantern-shaped cage around a simple violet luminous core, with a small top cap and a SHORT suspension chain of only three or four broad links plus a grip ring. Very faint wisp of purple smoke, so the solid shape is not hidden. Staff is dark-brown/charcoal with a chunky asymmetrical hooked head cradling one violet crystal, simple burgundy grip and muted gold band. Match Warlock burgundy, gold and purple. No skull ornaments or excessive detail. Labels: Censer, Staff.
